cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Choose the Real Impossibility
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which of two incompatible explanations will govern what everyone does next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before we move the sofa: are we shrinking while the room stays normal, or is the room growing while we stay normal?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Shrinking means call full-sized help. Growing means hurry before the door gets farther away. Choose.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We're shrinking. I'll call my brother.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell him to bring tweezers. He'll need to collect us afterward.

mechanism: A supervises a move by requiring B to choose between incompatible size explanations and follow the corresponding practical response.
confusable: Finding the true rule is D150; D154 forces a choice that will govern action even before truth is established.
comparison: A moving job and outside help differ from a buffet crew selecting a gravity plan.
seedUse: Keep growing-room versus shrinking-people consequences and brother help, with direct corrections of B's indecision.
